description.zh: 更新的业务类型。不超过64字符。由接入方自定义，可用于对具体业务进行备注，例如可以取接入方不同的人脸使用场景，或者待交付的客户标识等。
description.en: The updated business type. The value can be up to 64 characters in length. This parameter is defined by the requester and can be used to add remarks for specific business scenarios, such as different facial recognition usage scenarios or customer identifiers for pending deliveries.

description.zh: 实人认证服务端为接入方设备生成的唯一ID，只有在设备成功激活后才会生成，该ID可通过离线人脸识别SDK里的getLicenseExtraInfo函数获得。
description.en: The unique ID generated by the ID Verification server for the device of the requester. This ID is generated only after the device is successfully activated. You can obtain this ID by calling the getLicenseExtraInfo function in the offline facial recognition SDK.

description.zh: 延长设备到期的时间。单位：年，范围为\[1,100]，取值100表示永久使用。一年按365天计算。
description.en: The period by which to extend the device expiration time. Unit: years. Valid values: 1 to 100. A value of 100 indicates permanent use. One year is calculated as 365 days.

description.zh:
当前设备的失效时间。失效日期不正确（和实人认证服务端记录的失效时间相差超过一周），则报错。
> 该失效时间可以通过DescribeDeviceInfo接口查询获得，失效日期不正确则报错，这个校验是为了确保业务方不因为一些误操作导致重复激活一台设备，误消耗授权。
description.en:
The expiration time of the current device. An error is returned if the expiration date is incorrect (differs from the expiration time recorded on the ID Verification server by more than one week).
> You can query the expiration time by calling the DescribeDeviceInfo operation. An error is returned if the expiration date is incorrect. This validation ensures that the requester does not accidentally reactivate a device due to misoperations, which would unnecessarily consume authorization quotas.

description.zh: 更新的用户设备ID。不超过64字符，由接入方自定义，可用于标识具体设备，建议可以使用设备物理编号。
description.en: The updated user device ID. The value can be up to 64 characters in length. This parameter is defined by the requester and can be used to identify a specific device. We recommend that you use the physical device number.

descriptions.zh: 请求方法：支持以HTTPS POST和GET方法发送请求。
descriptions.en: Request method: You can send requests by using the HTTPS POST and GET methods.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloudauth modify-device-info --device-id wd.6ziUffspAeW5FVYbaqmexR-1qwNjM --user-device-id 3iJ1AY_oHcu7mC69 --biz-type FACE_TEST --duration 1 --expired-day 20190401 --api-version 2019-03-07 --region cn-hangzhou
